scientific_integrity: Exact analytic real-field PBH proof with a separately reproducible finite prime-field test. No claim of independent certification or exhaustive literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Two disjoint cliques of orders p,q>=3 with one bridge of positive conductance.
Uniform positive conductance within each clique; nonuniform within-clique edges are outside scope.
Independent coordinate input at each selected vertex; not one broadcast input.
Finite modular-rank tests corroborate but do not prove the parameter-uniform real-field theorem.
The zero-forcing polynomial of the graph is already established; no originality claimed for it.
Near-resonance conditioning and noise robustness are not quantified.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Weight-resonant controllability and zero forcing on two-clique barbells
